canonical_claim.template: In 2025, {value} of decisioned VA home-purchase applications in the US were denied (30,421 denials out of 369,275 applications reaching a credit decision).

required_qualifiers.population: decisioned VA home-purchase applications (loan_purpose 1; actions 1,2,3; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.denominator: applications reaching a credit decision, not all applications acted on

does_not_establish: the VA denial rate for all loan purposes or for refinance applications
that home-purchase loans are easier or harder to obtain than refinance loans for a given applicant (the applicant populations differ)
a comparison across programs as a judgement of programs or lenders
which denominator any other published figure used
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
